approved: Hazardous Waste (Regulation of Exports and Imports) Levy Bill 2016
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that would introduce a levy on hazardous waste import, export and transit permit applications.
The package would amend the existing Act to fully recover the costs of running the permit scheme, with the levy covering costs that cannot be linked to individual applicants.
The amendment bill would also allow the Department to publish permit applications and decisions on its website instead of in the Commonwealth Gazette.
Introduces a levy on permit applications for import, export and transit of hazardous waste.
Allows full cost recovery of the permit scheme, including costs not linked to individual applicants.
Streamlines administrative processes by permitting online publication of permit applications and decisions.
Applicants for hazardous waste import, export and transit permits, and the Department of the Environment and Energy.

The Hazardous Waste (Regulation of Exports and Imports) Amendment Bill 2016 and Levy Bill 2016 implement Australia's Basel Convention obligations, allow full cost recovery for permitting, and lift the $8,000 cap on waste imports/exports to ensure cost recovery, while the speaker also urged reducing the $500 billion national debt and returning the budget to surplus.
